rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits approximately 85-90% melanin saturation (dark pixels) across the superior and lateral surfaces, with a distinct pink/pale pixel cluster located at the central-inferior apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch is present on the superior-medial margin of the left ear pinna. A distinct dark, circular patch of fur or lesion is visible on the mid-posterior right flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant bimodal mane coloration, transitioning from light tawny on the dorsal/cranial surfaces to dark brown/black on the ventral/chest surfaces.
